semantic_role_rule.FORMAL_REFINEMENT_MAP_CANDIDATE: An explicit map iota/H_coarse→H_fine or equivalent mathematical construction between discretization levels is present.
semantic_role_rule.AMPLITUDE_CONSISTENCY_CANDIDATE: An explicit cylindrical/amplitude consistency relation across refinement levels is present.
semantic_role_rule.EXECUTABLE_COARSE_GRAINING_MAP_CANDIDATE: A concrete numerical/tensor contraction map from fine to effective coarse degrees of freedom is specified.
semantic_role_rule.KINEMATIC_REPRESENTATION_MAP_ONLY: The map changes representation/covariance data at a fixed discretization and must not be counted as coarse↔fine refinement.
semantic_role_rule.FRAMEWORK_ONLY: The source describes the programme but does not supply an executable map for the target Lorentzian DVD amplitude.

promotion_rule: No source is allowed to authorize a Lorentzian DVD refinement bridge unless a later compatibility gate demonstrates matching domain/codomain, boundary semantics, amplitude semantics, and no-retuning transport. Keyword overlap is never sufficient.
claim_locks: DVD shell depth D is not refinement.
Euclidean/q-deformed TNR and Lorentzian EPRL DVD amplitudes are not to be spliced without an explicit compatibility map.
Y/quantum-geometric SU(2)→SL(2,C) embeddings are not automatically coarse→fine discretization embeddings.
BRIDGE_DERIVED remains false until an executable held-out coarse↔fine amplitude gate passes.
